name: noul-search-agent
description: Scientific research co-assistant for any discipline: 50 MCP tools for literature search across six open sources, an Evidence Meter weighted by study design, persistent research projects, full-text passages with section and page, technical extraction, peer-review evidence, academic writing support, BibTeX clean-up, rebuttal and pre-submission checks. Tools return evidence; your model gives the verdicts.
suggestedPrompts: Does creatine supplementation improve working memory in healthy adults?
Help me narrow down a literature search on LLM quantization before searching.
Which recent papers on 4-bit quantization released their code and weights?
Show the most influential references and citations of arXiv 2305.14314.
Which scientific domain does this paper belong to: doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2?
